<thought>Applying template 1914398 to the product SMILES `O=[N+]([O-])c1c(Br)ccc2c1CC1(CCC1)O2` breaks the C–Br bond and yields the two reactants encoded in the forward reaction: dibromine (Br–Br) and the nitro‑aryl bicyclic scaffold without the bromine. The corresponding SMILES are `BrBr` and `O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c1CC1(CCC1)O2`. No alternative disconnections are generated by this template.</thought>
<final_answer>[["BrBr", "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c1CC1(CCC1)O2"]]</final_answer>
